data.description:
# Prune and rotate stale audit_debug JSONL files across worklog stores

**Issue type:** chore (maintenance/tooling) · **Priority:** critical · **Parent:** none

## Problem statement

Legacy `audit_debug_*.jsonl` forensic dumps have accumulated in worklog stores
on this host — ContextHub `.worklog` holds **48 files / 12.5 GB** (store total
13 GB) and `open_source_llm/.worklog` holds **33 files / 11.3 GB** (store total
11 GB), with single files up to ~1.9 GB last written 2026-08-01. A further
**2.5 GB** sits under `~/.audit_debug/`. These files make recursive greps read
multi-GB inputs (observed ~4.4 GB read, 12+ minutes, ~48% CPU) and inflate every
worklog/audit operation. No automation prunes either location, so the growth is
silent and unbounded.

## Users

- **Agents/operators running greps and audits on this host** — "As an agent
  running quality gates, I want stale debug dumps pruned and size-bounded
  automatically so scans stay fast and predictable."
- **Maintainer/producer** — "As a maintainer, I want retention enforced by
  automation (not one-off manual cleanups) so disk usage cannot silently reach
  tens of GB again."

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Retention sweep is implemented and unit-tested.** A repo-local script at
   `scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py` discovers `audit_debug_*.jsonl` files
   under every `~/projects/*/.worklog/` store and under `~/.audit_debug/**`, and
   selects for removal those older than `--older-than` days (default **7**) **or**
   larger than `--max-size` MB (default **50**). It is dry-run by default;
   `--apply` performs deletion. Pytest tests cover: age boundary, size boundary,
   non-matching filenames are never touched, missing root is a no-op, dry-run
   changes nothing, and `--apply` deletes exactly the selected set.
   *Verification:* `pytest tests/test_prune_audit_debug_logs.py` passes.
2. **Legacy backlog is reclaimed.** Running the sweep with `--apply` removes all
   legacy `audit_debug_*.jsonl` files from ContextHub `.worklog` (48 → 0) and
   `open_source_llm/.worklog` (33 → 0), reclaiming **≥ 20 GB**. Before/after
   aggregate counts and `du -sh` figures are recorded as a work-item comment.
   *Verification:* `ls <store>/audit_debug_*.jsonl` returns nothing for both
   stores; total reclaimed size recorded.
3. **Recurrence is prevented by automation.** A daily cron entry (installed by
   an idempotent `scripts/install-audit-log-hygiene.sh` helper, or documented as
   a copy-paste `crontab -l` snippet when auto-install is declined) runs the
   sweep with `--apply` and appends to a bounded log under `~/.audit_debug/`.
   Re-running the sweep immediately afterwards reports **no candidates**
   (idempotent). A `--check` mode exits non-zero when the post-sweep total
   debug-log footprint exceeds a configurable budget, suitable for manual or
   hook-driven use. *Verification:* unit tests assert exit codes for `--check`
   under/over budget; a second `--apply` run reports zero candidates.
4. **Policy and runbook are documented.** A docs page
   (`docs/dev/audit-debug-log-retention.md`) states the retention policy
   (locations, thresholds, dry-run/apply semantics, cron install and removal,
   safety guarantees, and the `~/.audit_debug` vs legacy `.worklog` distinction)
   and is linked from the relevant docs index. *Verification:* file exists and
   is linked; documented commands are copy-paste runnable.
5. **All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes** (code
   comments, README/docs site entries) **and the full project test suite passes
   with the new changes.**

## Constraints

- **Destructive-by-explicit-flag only.** Default is dry-run; deletion requires
  `--apply`. Only files matching `audit_debug_*.jsonl` are ever considered.
- **Never touch tracked or live data.** `.worklog/*` is git-ignored, but the
  sweep must not touch `worklog.db`/WAL/SHM, `config.yaml`, worktrees, or any
  non-debug file. Live SQLite worklog data is unaffected.
- **Repo boundaries.** Do **not** edit the SorraAgents-owned audit skill
  (`~/.pi/agent/skills/audit`, `skill/audit`) or other agent-infrastructure
  directories as part of this item. The existing
  `audit/scripts/cleanup_debug_logs.py` (14-day retention over `~/.audit_debug`,
  dry-run default) is **referenced, not forked**. Upstreaming the `~/.audit_debug`
  half into that skill is a follow-up, not scope.
- Deletions must be resilient to `OSError` (skip and continue, never abort the
  whole sweep) and must emit an audit line per removed file.
- Only aggregate counts/sizes are recorded in work-item comments — never log
  contents (forensic data may include provider payloads).
- **Scope-creep guard:** the broader machine-hygiene skill
  (WL-0MUJLCVRS0093EJJ) and any pre-commit/pre-push enforcement beyond a
  documented optional `--check` call are out of scope; record as follow-ups.

## Existing state

- `audit_runner.py` (SorraAgents `skill/audit`) now writes debug logs to
  `~/.audit_debug/<project-slug>/` (`_debug_log_dir`/`_default_debug_log_path`)
  and deletes them on a successful run (`_remove_debug_log`). New logs therefore
  no longer land in `.worklog/`, so the 24 GB in the two worklog stores is stale
  legacy data that will not regrow.
- `cleanup_debug_logs.py` already sweeps `~/.audit_debug` (files >14 days,
  dry-run default, `--apply` to delete) but is **not automated** and does **not**
  cover legacy `.worklog` locations.
- No cron entry exists for audit-log pruning (only an `llm-wiki` job is present).
- `.gitignore` ignores `.worklog/*`, so legacy files are untracked and safe to
  delete; repo scan helpers (`audit/scripts/scan.py`) already exclude
  `**/audit_debug_*.jsonl` and `.audit_debug/**`.

## Desired change

1. Add a self-contained retention script (Python, stdlib-only) with the
   discovery, age/size selection, dry-run/apply, and `--check` semantics above.
2. Add pytest coverage for selection, safety, idempotence, and exit codes.
3. Add an idempotent cron-install helper plus documentation; optionally surface
   a `--check` call from an existing hook as a non-fatal warning.
4. Reclaim the existing backlog with a recorded before/after.
5. Document the policy/runbook.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py` — **new**: discovery + age/size selection +
  dry-run/`--apply`/`--check`; mirrors `cleanup_debug_logs.py` conventions.
- `scripts/install-audit-log-hygiene.sh` — **new**: idempotent cron entry
  installer (with `--remove`), logging to `~/.audit_debug/hygiene-cron.log`.
- `tests/test_prune_audit_debug_logs.py` — **new**: pytest unit tests over a
  temp directory tree (age boundary, size boundary, dry-run, apply, check mode).
- `docs/dev/audit-debug-log-retention.md` — **new**: policy + runbook.
- `.gitignore` — **review**: confirm `.worklog/*` already covers these paths
  (expected: no change needed).
- `.githooks/pre-push` — **optional**: non-fatal `--check` warning (only if the
  producer opts in; otherwise out of scope).

## Risks & assumptions

- **Assumption — placement:** tooling lives in ContextHub `scripts/` (this
  item's home repo) and is machine-scoped via `~/projects/*` discovery, rather
  than editing the SorraAgents-owned audit skill. *Open to producer redirection.*
- **Assumption — delete over archive:** the seed permits "archive … or delete";
  we delete, because these are transient forensics already documented as such by
  the audit skill and the reclaimed volume (≥20 GB) is the point. If cold
  storage is required, add a `--archive-dir` (gzip) variant before deletion.
- **Risk — over-broad glob.** A loose pattern could match non-debug files; the
  `audit_debug_*.jsonl` prefix/suffix guard and tests mitigate this.
- **Risk — deleting useful forensics.** Retention is age/size based; files
  newer than the threshold are kept. The 7-day/50 MB defaults are aggressive but
  match the seed; they are CLI-configurable.
- **Risk — scope creep** into machine hygiene / hooks. Guarded above; extras
  become linked follow-up items.
- **Assumption — default retention:** 7 days / 50 MB per the seed, with a
  total-footprint `--check` budget (proposed: 5 GB) documented and configurable.

## Related work

- **WL-0MUJLCVRS0093EJJ** — Create a machine-hygiene skill that evaluates
  performance pressure and proposes remediations (explicitly references this
  item as a root cause; the manual analysis that discovered the runaway grep).
- **WL-0MKTLALHV0U51LWN** — Reduce sync output; add rotating logs (completed;
  precedent for rotating-log handling in `wl sync`).
- SorraAgents `skill/audit/scripts/cleanup_debug_logs.py` — existing retention
  sweep for `~/.audit_debug` (referenced, not forked).
- SorraAgents `skill/audit/scripts/scan.py` — already excludes
  `audit_debug_*.jsonl` / `.audit_debug/**` from scans.
- SorraAgents `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — `_debug_log_dir` (moved
  logs out of `.worklog/`), `_remove_debug_log` (deletes on success).

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- **No blocking interview was required** — the seed context (work item
  description) specified the strategy, thresholds (7 days / 50 MB), locations,
  and automation mechanism (cron) sufficiently to draft this brief.
- Q: Where should the retention tooling live, given the audit skill is owned by
  the SorraAgents repo? — Answer (agent, documented assumption): this item's home
  repo, ContextHub `scripts/`, with machine-scoped discovery; marked as an
  assumption open to producer redirection. Source: repo inspection
  (`~/.pi/agent/skills/audit` → `SorraAgents/skill/audit`; ContextHub `skill/`
  has no audit skill) + work-item seed.
- Q: Archive to cold storage or delete? — Answer (seed context): either is
  acceptable; **delete** selected as the default with an `--archive-dir` escape
  hatch if cold storage is later required. Source: work item description
  ("archive older files to cold storage or delete").
- Q: What automation mechanism? — Answer (seed context): **cron-based** daily
  `--apply` sweep, plus a `--check` mode for manual/hook use. Source: work item
  description ("implement a cron-based rotation").
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **WL-0MSI8H3HP000K0RG** – Allow /skill:audit on complete/in_review items without a valid audit (completed)
- **WL-0MSAWAQNM006PAVJ** – Plugin delegates to shared resolver (completed)
- **WL-0MKRSO1KD1NWWYBP** – Persist Worklog DB across executions; refresh from JSONL when newer (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `packages/herdr/README.md` — matched: abort, acceptable, acceptance, add, again (+307 more)
- `CLI.md` — matched: abort, add, again, age, agent (+258 more)
- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md` — matched: abort, add, again, age, agent (+254 more)
